item.title: Stale Keep-Alive Connections on AWS Lambda
item.description: A Go Lambda function that reuses HTTP keep-alive connections can fail with Post "…": EOF on the first request after a pause. The server closed the idle connection while the function was frozen, and Go’s HTTP client hands out the dead connection before it notices. Setting the transport’s IdleConnTimeout below the server’s keep-alive timeout prevents the common case, a connection the server closed for being idle. It doesn’t cover servers that close connections for other reasons, such as a deploy or a restart.

item.title: json.Unmarshal Doesn't Clear Your Struct: A Pagination Bug Story
item.description: json.Unmarshal only sets the fields that appear in the JSON. If you decode several responses into the same struct, a field missing from a later response keeps its value from an earlier one. In a pagination loop that can mean the “next page” token never becomes empty, and the loop never ends. This started with a Go service at work that replicates users from another service, page by page. After a small change in the API’s responses, the consumer got stuck in an infinite loop.
